description: Paris asking-price estimator trained on unique, structurally valid SeLoger listings. It is not a transaction-price model.

preprocessing.numeric_precision: float32; apply Math.fround to every encoded value in JavaScript
preprocessing.unknown_category_encoding: all zeros after applying input policy

uncertainty.method: Symmetric finite-sample conformal intervals calibrated on absolute out-of-fold log residuals

javascript_scoring_contract.tree_traversal: Apply Math.fround to encoded features. Start at node 0; while children_left[node] !== -1, go left when features[feature[node]] <= threshold[node], otherwise right; return value[node] at the leaf.
javascript_scoring_contract.interval_formula: [Math.exp(log_prediction - q), Math.exp(log_prediction + q)] where q is the selected absolute_log_residual_quantile
